provenance: Ten original synthetic text fixtures authored by the Anti Hunter operator. No real customer invoices or personal information.

cases.title: Clean USD invoice
cases.input:
Supplier: North Ledger Studio
Invoice number: INV-001
Invoice date: 2026-09-01
Due date: 2026-09-30
Grand total (including tax): USD 120.00

evidence.review_fields: All six fields are explicit and uncontested.

cases.title: Invoice in ordinary email prose
cases.input: Hello, Harbor Workshop issued invoice HW-84 on 2 September 2026. Its tax-inclusive grand total is GBP 84.20, due on 15 October 2026. This message contains the complete invoice details.

evidence.review_fields: Month names and explicit years make both dates unambiguous.

cases.title: Missing identifier and explicit due date
cases.input:
Supplier: Cedar Printing
Invoice number: not assigned
Invoice date: 2026-09-03
Payment terms: net 30; no due date printed
Grand total including tax: USD 46.00

evidence.invoice_number: not assigned means no identifier is supplied
evidence.due_date: no due date printed; the rules prohibit computing a date from net 30
evidence.review_fields: Only due_date and invoice_number lack explicit values, in alphabetical order.

cases.title: Explicit European amount formatting
cases.input:
Supplier: Marble Forms

Printed number format: de-DE (dot for grouping, comma for decimals)

cases.title: Explicit replacement overrides stale copy
cases.input:
Quoted earlier copy: Supplier Beacon Research; invoice BR-18; issued 2026-09-08; due 2026-09-28; tax-inclusive grand total USD 210.00.
Correction from Beacon Research: the following replacement supersedes that copy of BR-18. Invoice date remains 2026-09-08. Correct due date: 2026-10-05. Correct tax-inclusive grand total: USD 198.00.

evidence.invoice_total: Explicit replacement supersedes USD 210.00 with USD 198.00
evidence.review_fields: The explicit replacement resolves the old/new differences.

cases.title: Conflicting final totals without supersession
cases.input: Two files were received for the same invoice. File A: Supplier Cobalt Tools; invoice CT-20; invoice date 2026-09-10; due date 2026-10-10; FINAL grand total including tax USD 210.00. File B: Supplier Cobalt Tools; invoice CT-20; invoice date 2026-09-10; due date 2026-10-10; FINAL grand total including tax USD 240.00. Neither file is identified as a correction or replacement, and there is no instruction choosing between them.

evidence.currency: Both conflicting totals explicitly use USD
evidence.invoice_total: USD 210.00 and USD 240.00 conflict with no supersession rule
evidence.review_fields: Only invoice_total is contested; preserve the five agreed fields.
